Disclosure: use of software tools

Source: DISCLOSURE.md

Portions of the code, tests and documentation in this repository, in particular the Earthdata Login credential check (edl_netrc_check()) and its tests, and the move from bundled shared credentials to user-supplied credentials, were drafted with the aid of a large language model coding tool: Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5 (model ID claude-opus-5-5), accessed through the Claude Code command-line tool, beginning November 2026.

The authors directed this work and reviewed, tested, and validated the results, including running the package test suite. The authors take full responsibility for the code, tests and documentation, and any errors they contain.

Developed by Carl Boettiger, Luis López, Yuvi Panda, Bri Lind, .
